General

New
Oh, Great One! Please look kindly upon this offering!
Cookie Info & Loading
She should be callin' for me any time now... This's pointless. Just run.
You... You're not alone, are you? I'll cut down every trace of wickedness...
There's a foul energy spread thick across this place...! Promise the tired thing isn't just an act...
This'd cause even the wickedest of spirits to wail... Where're you going at this time of night...?

Tired

Lobby

Daily Reward
Stick around for the end of the ritual...
Tap
D'you have any idea how hard it is to wipe the sacred blades clean of kimchi brine? Will a day ever come when my sorrows are eased?
Y've gotta take care of all the evil spirits. Why else would I bother coming all the way here? I enjoy the exorcism rituals... 'Cause I know I've got Her by my side...
Any exorcist Cookie who says they aren't tired after a ritual's gotta be a complete sham... There isn't an exorcist Cookie who's not got somethin' heavy weighing on their shoulders.
What're you doing? Stop bringin' such weird things and energies back... That's enough... Let's get moving.
I don't have strong energy... They're just weak. I don't need your praises... It's all 'cause I've got Her on my side...
Conditional
(These quotes require certain conditions to be met in order to trigger it in your Lobby)
When placed in the Seasonless Celestial Garden Lobby I'm feelin' pretty energetic!
Time to let the kimchi brine fly!
When placed in a Lobby with Gim Cookie or  Spiritual Banisher If you feel sleep comin' for you, might as well rest... Don't blame me when I've exorcised all the spirits.
When placed in a Lobby with White Kimchi Cookie or  Serene Star Shaman Who's got time to sit here listenin' to see if it's a malicious spirit or not?!
Gift
Neutral Haven't I told ya to not bring useless things to rituals?
Given Well-Brined Sacred Blade Nothing beats these when it comes time to run around after malicious spirits!
Given Royal Golden Dough Like the sunlight reflecting off the sacred swords...

General

Cookie Info & Loading
I'll cut down every trace of wickedness...* She should be callin for me any time now...
There's a foul energy spread thick across this place...!* Promise the tired thing isn't just an act...*
If y'hadn't come to pick on Cookies, I wouldn't hafta do this!* A Divine energy lingers in my blades! Just try me!
Who'd'ya think you are?! My blades'll make easy work of you! How unlucky for ya to have run into me of all Cookies.

Tired
Urgh... Be gone with all of you...

Lobby

Daily Reward
A gift. From the Great Generals.
Tap
Fish sauce to wash away the rotten energy, salt to bind the evil spirits, and chili peppers to burn them right away! Not just anyone can do a ritual like this... I'm here 'cause of the nights I endured all alone in a dark shrine...
I'm borrowing the Great Generals' strength... 'f course I've gotta bear the weight of that... While I'm dancin around getting kimchi brine everywhere I'm like a whole different Cookie... Can't even feel the exhaustion!
Can't let dust build up on the bells or blades, no matter how tired y'are... It brings bad fortune! There're things I swore to protect and failed... That is my true sorrow.
What's got your dough so worn down? Got somethin malicious trailing you? Can't help it if I'm tired... Great Generals, please lend me your strength...
My blades were gettin ready to rust... Prepare yourself! Don't mention it... I took up these blades to protect Cookies...
Conditional
